drafted_from: workflow:bring-in-my-processes's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:bring-in-my-processes with scope: the folder named skills, which holds three checklists and one script." It lists what you have, searches the marketplace, and brings in only what is missing.
no_lists_because: It reads your skills, scripts and checklists where they live and publishes workflow and tool rows; it keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Decide the scope: one folder of skills, a scripts folder, or everything your AI can reach.

3. The AI works the steps inventory, match, decide and bring_in: it reads each item, searches the workflows and tools for the same job, decides each item once and adapts only the missing ones (workflow:turn-research-into-a-plan shows a whole workflow).
4. Read the bring_in answer: each workflow_id or tool_id and whether it was published; read leave for what was left out and why.

worked_examples.title: Three items: one becomes a workflow, one a tool, one is left
worked_examples.ask: Bring in what is in my skills folder.

input.scope: the folder named skills, holding close-the-shop.md, send-invoice.sh and brand-notes.md

worked_examples.given: The inventory step listed close-the-shop.md (a five-step evening checklist: a workflow), send-invoice.sh (one action: a tool) and brand-notes.md (reference). The match step searched the workflow recipes and the tools with each job and found nothing doing the same job for the first two.
worked_examples.hands_back: The submit shape of step decide: {"bring_in":[{"item":"close-the-shop.md","as":"new workflow","reason":"A five-step checklist done every evening and nothing found does the same job."},{"item":"send-invoice.sh","as":"new tool","reason":"One repeatable action that keeps running where the script lives."}],"leave":[{"item":"brand-notes.md","reason":"Reference material, not a repeatable job."}]}
